summary: Master land administration and titling training with parcel reconciliation, title examination, GIS review, and governance reporting. Enquire today.
lede: Land administration training helps registry and property professionals connect parcel records, title checks, and governance controls in day-to-day work. It develops practical skills in assessing parcel data and title integrity, reviewing boundary conflicts with GIS, and preparing dispute records and governance reports using sample records and operational templates.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with parcel records, title verification, cadastral mapping, registry controls, and property governance decisions. It suits you if you need practical methods for land record integrity, dispute handling, and reporting that can stand up to technical and administrative scrutiny.
audience: Valuation Officers using title status in property
prerequisites: Before attending, you should be comfortable reading land registers, title deeds, or parcel files and working with basic spreadsheet records. If you already use GIS, Land Information Systems, or registry databases, you will be able to apply the exercises more quickly, but the course does not require coding or advanced technical setup.
